full_judgment:
Latifur Rahman J : Accused-petitioner, Sumarendra Nath Goswami, an Advocate by profession, was discharged in CR Case No. 278C/87 under section 241A of the Code of Criminal Procedure by the Additional District Magistrate, Naogaon on 22-10-89. Against the said order of discharge the respondent moved the Sessions Judge, Naogaon in revision and the Additional Sessions Judge, Naogaon by his judgment and order dated 31-7-96 in Criminal Motion No. 558 of 1989 set aside the order of discharge and directed to proceed with the case. Against the said judgment and order the accused-petitioner preferred Criminal Miscellaneous Case No. 5592 of 1996 and a learned Judge of the High Court Division summarily rejected the application on 26.11.96. The accused-petitioner being aggrieved by the order of summary rejection of the High Court Division has preferred this leave petition. 

 3. In this case, cognizance was taken and thereafter the case was sent to the Additional District Magistrate, Naogaon as it was triable by him. On 22-10-89, the accused was discharged by the Additional District Magistrate, Naogaon. Thereafter the complainant moved the Sessions Judge in revision and the Motion was allowed and the Additional District Magistrate was directed to proceed with the trial in accordance with law. 

 7. It appears from the judgment of the High Court Division that the Additional District Magistrate twice discharged the accused in spite of the earlier order of the superior Court wherein the discharge order was set aside and the Additional District Magistrate was directed to proceed with the case. The superior Court has already called for an explanation from the Additional District Magistrate concerned. It is for the Magistrate concerned to explain his conduct under what circumstances he flouted the order of the superior Court.
